# Seeds whose SELF-HOST x86-64 result disagrees with the interpreter's, for
# TestDifferential_SelfHostX86_64 (internal/testing/e2e/diff_oracle_selfhost_test.go).
#
# Format: <seed> <reason + issue>. Blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# A row is a known compiler bug tolerated so the rest of the corpus keeps
# running. The leg fails on a new divergence and on a listed seed that starts
# agreeing, so the list can only shrink. It is empty.
#
# A typed-lowering refusal prints `FERN_SEM_IR: <declaration>: <reason>` and the
# compile exits 3; the leg only proves what it could compile, so read a run's
# gap count beside its divergences.
